policy: Nova's existing '(Vieira)' equivalence labels are treated as search clues, not crosswalk evidence.
Projeciologia framework entities such as psicossoma and energossoma remain external constructs and are not imported into Nova ontology.
Phenomenological resemblance can be mapped independently of the framework explanation offered for that phenomenon.
No Vieira concept is mapped with an identity relation.
Institutional descriptions by IIPC are treated as primary-adjacent statements of the Vieira framework, not independent scientific validation.

concepts.label: Estado vibracional
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
concepts.notes: Framework describes a vibration condition involving energossoma/psicossoma; crosswalk uses only the reported vibration phenomenology.

concepts.label: Decolagem do psicossoma
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
concepts.notes: Framework transition in which the psychosome is said to leave the physical-body coincidence state.

concepts.label: Psicossoma
concepts.notes: Source framework treats psychosome as an emotional/extraphysical vehicle of manifestation.

concepts.label: Semiprojeção / projeção parcial
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção Consciente Fragmentada
concepts.notes: Partial exteriorization in which only part of the framework-defined psychosome is described as displaced.

concepts.label: Projeção semiconsciente
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção Consciente Fragmentada
concepts.notes: Described as a projection condition with discontinuous/partial lucidity; source literature also compares it with lucid dreaming.

concepts.label: Catalepsia projetiva
concepts.notes: Temporary inability to move the physical body while awareness is present; Vieira's causal vehicle explanation remains external.

concepts.label: Ballonnement / balonamento
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
concepts.notes: Reported sensation of bodily swelling/expansion before or around takeoff in the Projectiology framework.

mappings.basis: Both systems describe a subjectively perceived whole-body or intense vibration condition associated with a separation/threshold context. The Projectiology explanation in terms of energossoma and psicossoma is not part of the NC mapping.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
mappings.warning: Phenomenological similarity only; no import of vehicle ontology.

mappings.basis: Both denote a transition away from ordinary bodily localization rather than the later destination/outcome. Vieira describes psychosome takeoff; Nova models a perceived shift of the center of perception.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
mappings.warning: The external concept presupposes a psychosome; Nova Décrochage does not.

mappings.basis: Nova Corps de sortie records the perception of a different/light/fluid body, while the Vieira framework treats Psicossoma as an actual vehicle of manifestation. The overlap is experiential imagery/body-ownership phenomenology, not ontology.
mappings.warning: Never encode Psicossoma = Corps de sortie. Nova explicitly keeps Corps de sortie at the level of perception.

mappings.basis: IIPC describes semiprojection as partial exteriorization and gives limb-by-limb examples; Nova Sortie partielle likewise models an incomplete exit-like transition affecting only part of the perceived body.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção Consciente Fragmentada
mappings.warning: The phenomenological structure aligns strongly, but the explanatory ontology differs.

mappings.basis: Projectiology describes semiconscious projection through discontinuous/partial lucidity and sometimes glosses it as lucid-dream-like. Nova separates the degree of lucidity from the dream-environment category, so the external concept overlaps two NC nodes rather than one.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção Consciente Fragmentada
IIPC educational glossary derived from Vieira framework
mappings.warning: Do not collapse Semi-lucidité and Rêve lucide into one NC state.

mappings.basis: Both describe temporary inability to move the physical body while awareness is present around sleep/transition states. The Vieira framework adds a vehicle-coincidence explanation that is not imported into Nova.
mappings.warning: Operational overlap is strong; causal explanations and clinical terminology remain distinct.

mappings.basis: Nova currently has no canonical node specifically describing the bodily swelling/inflation sensation named ballonnement in the Projectiology material.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
mappings.warning: Do not force-map this to Flottement or Dissolution des frontières merely because all concern altered embodiment.
